Oculos enim natura nobis ad motus animorum

page.notes: Printed text is in a 16th-century roman face with long s rendered as s; the catchword "PRAE-" and signature "I 3" are at the foot. Some words in the first paragraph are doubtful, notably "niendis", "Oculi", "coniectu", and "cofe quemur"; these are transcribed as printed but may contain errors. Words "tum intentione" and "bilaritate" are transcribed as printed.
